currentParagraphText: “Whatever happens is not on me,” Jake simply spoke, not going to get dragged into that logic. They had already established that the Holy Church was the one that had stolen the Truesoul in the first place. Jake wasn’t going to feel bad for whatever happened next.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “But it will be your doing,” the Lodestar Matron said before sighing.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I return that question to you. Are you willing to kill anyone and everything standing in your way to get a Truesoul you have no use for? Simply to deny us having it?”
